prompts.yato: Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer. Edit target: supplied pixel background of rabbit family root-cellar storehouse. This is a production playable background for an existing 2D top-down oblique pixel RPG. Repaint the same exact scene and perspective, preserving the layout and spatial proportions: earthen root ceiling, circular four-pane window at rear left about 35% across, small table at extreme left, wooden storage shelves along back right, broad uninterrupted packed-earth floor from 40% image height to bottom. Preserve EMPTY shelves with only a few straw remnants; scarcity is central to the story. No food piles. Upgrade it to clean meticulous handcrafted pixel art with readable clustered pixels, crisp material edges and deliberate 4-6-tone shading per material. Rich warm walnut joinery, worn shelf edges and visible dowel joints, layered twisted roots, irregular clay bricks, fine sparse straw and gentle foot-worn earth surface. Window has a precise wooden mullion, muted green forest beyond, restrained golden stepped pixel daylight falling diagonally onto the floor. Clear contact shadows below walls and shelf legs. Floor must have natural non-repeating patches; remove blurry repeated bands. Preserve the bottom central 70% as walkable floor with only tiny flat texture; do not place furniture or obstacles there. No people, animals, fans, characters, text, symbols, HUD, captions, borders, magical items. No new story content. Quiet warm brown earth, amber highlights, cool brown-violet shadows; avoid excessively orange saturation, painterly noise, blur, smooth gradients, tiling stripes or photographic textures. Full bleed landscape aspect ratio approximately 1.564:1. Pixel art background only; make it detailed and spatially coherent when displayed at 904 by 578.
prompts.danming: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: production environment background for the existing 2D pixel RPG. Edit the provided background preserving its exact camera angle, composition, room boundaries, positions of every major prop, and open walking area. Upgrade to meticulous high quality hand-authored pixel art: deliberate crisp pixel clusters, carved edges, readable joinery, material-specific 4-6 tone shading, contact shadows and coherent directional light. Reduce mottled visual noise and repetitive ground texture. The playable middle and lower region must remain unobstructed and calmer than the detailed margins. Keep the same story setting. No characters, animals, new narrative items, text, signs, UI or borders. No gaussian blur, smooth vector look or realistic photo surfaces. Full bleed 1.564:1 landscape. Warm fairy arrow workshop late in the working day. Keep rear table at exactly the original location and height: its top occupies x=10%-48%, y=16%-24% and remains visible for existing interactive overlays. Brass drawer pulls, hand-planed oak grain, tool shadows, thread bobbins and stacked ordinary arrow shafts around the rear and side edges. Muted rose-brown and plum shadows, honey light through the upper-left small-paned window. Calm middle floor; no extra worktables or stools in the aisle. Preserve existing heart arrow motif only in already implied craft details.
